description: Native graph database platform storing and querying connected data, supporting vector search, graph analytics, and AI knowledge graphs.
auth_notes: Connects via Bolt protocol or query APIs using database username and password, or bearer tokens/API keys for Aura cloud management.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Neo4j AuraDB instance tier or download the free community edition instantly with no credit card required.
api_notes: Comprehensive programmatic access via Bolt binary protocol, official language drivers (Python, JavaScript, etc.), HTTP query APIs, and cloud provisioning APIs.
mcp_notes: Neo4j Labs publishes official MCP servers under neo4j-contrib/mcp-neo4j supporting Cypher queries, memory graphs, cloud management, and data modeling.
rationale: Neo4j provides fully documented native drivers, HTTP query capabilities, free self-serve Aura instances, and official Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

evidence.note: AuraDB Free plan is available at $0 with no credit card or payment method required.
Neo4j Labs official MCP servers repository maintained by Neo4j Field GenAI team.
